hero.headline: Physics, chaos and a little bit of magic.
hero.intro: I'm Elarion, and I make browser games where things explode, shatter and pile up. Join the newsletter to follow each new game from its first prototype to launch.

newsletter.heading: Follow the journey
newsletter.body: Get an email when there's something worth showing: new prototypes, behind-the-scenes notes and early playtest invites.
newsletter.consentText: I'd like to receive the Elarion newsletter and I've read the {privacy}. I can unsubscribe at any time.
newsletter.finePrint: No spam, ever. You'll confirm your address first, and every email has a one-click unsubscribe link.
newsletter.successBody: I've sent you a confirmation link. Click it to finish subscribing. Nothing there after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.
newsletter.closedMessage: The newsletter opens very soon. Check back in a day or two!
newsletter.confirmedBody: Thanks for confirming your email. The next devlog will land straight in your inbox. Until then, why not play one of the prototypes?

items.title: The Elarion site is live
items.body: A home for my games, and a newsletter for everyone who wants to follow along.

about.heading: About Elarion
about.body:
Elarion is the name I make games under. I build for the browser, prototype fast and share the process along the way, including the parts that don't work.

Right now I'm exploring physics-heavy ideas: hordes, destruction and satisfying chaos. Subscribe and you'll see each new prototype first.

cta.heading: Don't miss the next game
cta.body: One email when there's something new to play. No spam, unsubscribe any time.

seo.title: Elarion · Indie game developer
seo.description: Elarion makes physics-driven browser games. Play the prototypes and join the newsletter to follow the journey.
